title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Maya Puthagum
desc: Guru, an assistant director, dreams of a dragon, which leads him to a mysterious book and its owner. The latter instructs him to meet a producer at a palace to film the manuscript's contents.

title: Bangarraju
desc: A deceased couple returns to Earth to help their grandson, who lost his way in life after familial and personal problems start to haunt him.

title: Mr. Zoo Keeper
desc: A zookeeper dedicated to taking care of wild animals finds himself in a difficult situation with law enforcement officials.

title: Mera Badla Revenge 2
desc: Satyajith seeks the help of a yogi when he is troubled by strange visions. He comes to know that the property he purchased a couple of years ago is haunted by a spirit.

title: Rathnam
desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl from attackers during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he wonders how long he can keep her safe.
